meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude在每次回答前会先回想相关的过往对话,并在每轮结束后把新的要点存入记忆。这些记忆按智能体工作区分开保存,容器重启后依然存在。
howto.when: 当智能体使用默认的Claude提供商时,每次容器启动会启用记忆功能,之后Claude在每次回应前调取相关记忆,每轮后保存新内容。

say.text: 你还记得我之前提过的那个客户需求吗?
say.note: Claude会检索相关记忆并回应。

say.text: 请记住这个数据:本月销售额为100万。
say.note: 这条信息会被存入长期记忆。

say.text: 结合我们过去的讨论,给我一些建议。
say.note: Claude会基于已有记忆生成回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude recalls relevant past conversations before responding and stores new insights after each turn. Memory is kept per agent group in the .claude mount and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the agent group uses the default Claude provider (no 'provider' key or 'provider':'claude'). On each container start, hooks fire before responding and after each turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the client requirement I mentioned earlier?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve relevant memory and respond.

say_en.text: Please remember this data: monthly sales are 1 million.
say_en.note: This will be saved to long-term memory.

say_en.text: Based on our past discussions, give me some advice.
say_en.note: Claude will answer using existing memory.
